{{Navbar-Global Gas Infrastructure Tracker}}
'''Cameron Interstate Pipeline''' is an operating natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://semprainfrastructure.com/what-we-do/energy-networks/cameron-interstate-pipeline/|title=semprainfrastructure.com|website=semprainfrastructure.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline runs from Cameron LNG terminal, Cameron Parish, Louisiana to Louisiana.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://semprainfrastructure.com/what-we-do/energy-networks/cameron-interstate-pipeline/|title=semprainfrastructure.com|website=semprainfrastructure.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Project Details==
*'''Owner: '''Sempra Infrastructure Partners LP<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://semprainfrastructure.com/what-we-do/energy-networks/cameron-interstate-pipeline/|title=semprainfrastructure.com|website=semprainfrastructure.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2006-08-30/pdf/E6-14393.pdf|title=govinfo.gov|website=govinfo.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Capacity: '''2,350 MMcf/d<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://semprainfrastructure.com/what-we-do/energy-networks/cameron-interstate-pipeline/|title=semprainfrastructure.com|website=semprainfrastructure.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Length: '''36.5 mi<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://semprainfrastructure.com/what-we-do/energy-networks/cameron-interstate-pipeline/|title=semprainfrastructure.com|website=semprainfrastructure.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Diameter: '''42 in<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://semprainfrastructure.com/what-we-do/energy-networks/cameron-interstate-pipeline/|title=semprainfrastructure.com|website=semprainfrastructure.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2006-08-30/pdf/E6-14393.pdf|title=govinfo.gov|website=govinfo.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Status: '''Operating<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://semprainfrastructure.com/what-we-do/energy-networks/cameron-interstate-pipeline/|title=semprainfrastructure.com|website=semprainfrastructure.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Proposal year: '''2005<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2006-08-30/pdf/E6-14393.pdf|title=govinfo.gov|website=govinfo.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
